minutes.headline: Planning Board approved the Settlers Solar special permit and site plan, endorsed an ANR plan, and heard marijuana cultivation.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed an ANR plan for the Gilchrist Street land conveyance and waived site plan review at 31 School Street. It discussed non-medical marijuana cultivation, leaning toward indoor-only in the industrial zone. It then voted on the Settlers Solar permit after a motion initially failed for lack of a second, held a public hearing on five zoning articles for Town Meeting, and took committee reports.

public_comment.topic: Asked whether the Chapter 40A agricultural exemption differs between medical and recreational marijuana.
Asked the board to reiterate waste disposal, energy and water use, lighting and pesticide rules for cultivation in the bylaw.
Asked that small cultivation facilities on large parcels be considered, not only large industrial ones.
Supports prohibition and opposes small facilities in random places; says cultivation is industrial.
Opposed another marijuana moratorium; asked what came out of the planning work in the past year and a half.
Supports the moratorium as a path to planning; says Question 4 was not a vote on shops or cultivation.
Asked what lighted means for the sign amendment and about home-business signs.
Asked how sign setbacks are measured and how the right-of-way definition is interpreted.
Asked how the special permit time-limit article differs from the one Town Meeting already voted down.
Urged that the moratorium be explained as planning, not an anti-marijuana vote.

votes.motion: Approve the ANR plan for the Gilchrist Street conveyance.
Waive site plan approval for 31 School Street.
Grant the Settlers Solar special permit with a pre-construction meeting condition and removal of Mr. Bittner's signature references.
Re-made motion to grant the Settlers Solar special permit with the amendments.
Approve the Settlers Solar site plan.
Accept the section 2.1 definitions article, but the vote was deferred until the hearing closed.
Close the public hearing on the zoning articles.
Approve the five zoning article amendments, allowing minor changes on the floor.
Change the open space ad hoc committee to add one at-large member and remove one Conservation Commission seat.

budget_items.topic: Marijuana economic development and tax revenue
budget_items.what_was_said: A resident argued marijuana is a major economic development opportunity the town could miss. Another resident said the tax money could be good for the community.
Survey respondents ranked office park industrial, commercial and outlying districts as the top three locations.

decisions.decision: The stormwater permit for Settlers Solar was put off to the November 5 meeting, with the applicant agreeing to the delay and the planner to draft a decision.
The craft marijuana cooperative will be discussed separately, and marijuana processing and testing labs on November 5.
Board consensus to limit non-medical cultivation to indoor facilities in the industrial zone.
The five warrant articles go to the November 13 Special Town Meeting.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board granted the Settlers Solar special permit at 994 Northfield Road after a first motion failed for lack of a second.
The board then approved the Settlers Solar site plan, and put the stormwater permit off to the November 5 meeting with the applicant's agreement.
The board agreed by consensus to limit non-medical marijuana cultivation to indoor facilities in the industrial zone, and set other marijuana topics for November 5.
After a public hearing, five zoning articles were sent to the November 13 Special Town Meeting; the votes on them were not audible in the recording.
The board endorsed an ANR plan for the Gilchrist Street conveyance and waived site plan review at 31 School Street.

why_it_matters: Where marijuana cultivation can be sited, and whether a moratorium is adopted while rules are written, will shape land use in town and may reach residents as a Town Meeting vote.
The solar permit sets conditions on a large installation on Northfield Road, and the stormwater decision still to come governs how runoff from the site is handled.
watch_next: November 5 Planning Board meeting: the Settlers Solar stormwater permit, and discussion of marijuana processing, testing labs and the craft cooperative.
November 13 Special Town Meeting: the five zoning articles from the public hearing.
